rules: Never substitute local receive time for provider event time
Never substitute provider receive time for provider event time
Never merge dxFeed bid_time and ask_time into a synthetic event time
Preserve raw provider timestamp representation and exact epoch_ns
Local receive time is a non-negative integer epoch nanoseconds
Signed deltas are observations, not pure network latency claims
signed_deltas: event_to_local_delta_ns = local_receive_ns - provider_event_time_ns when event time exists
provider_receive_to_local_delta_ns = local_receive_ns - provider_receive_time_ns when provider receive time exists
